text_block_list.text:
"Considering today's weather... wind speed and humidity...
...Yeah, this should work."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-kun.
I have finished revising the theory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... That is a foolish question.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The more refined a theory is, the simpler it becomes.
Allow me to show you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The ultimate answer that is victory...!
